ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the 30h day of January, 2020, by and between STEINWAY, INC. ("Owner"), a Delaware corporation, having an office at One Steinway Place, Astoria, New York 11105, and WF Industrial IV LLC (*Wildflower"), a Delaware limited liability company having an address at 80 Eighth Avenue, Suite 1602, New York, New York 10011. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Steinway is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and. improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Queens, County of Queens and City and State of New York,known as Lot 1 in Block 814 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Queens (the “"Tax Map"), and as and by the street address One Steinway Place, Astoria, New York, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Steinway Land"; said buildings and improvements, together with future alterations and replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein referred to, together, as the “Steinway Buildings"; and the Steinway Land and the Steinway Buildings are herein collectively referred to as the “Steinway Parcel"); WHEREAS, Wildflower is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Queens, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 10 in Block 814 on the Tax Map, and as and by the street address 36-01 19uh Avenue, Astoria, New York 11005, and more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed “Existing Wildflower Buildings"); WHEREAS, the Steinway Land and the Wildflower Land constitute a single zoning lot, as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resoluition (as hereinafter defined; the "Single Zoning_Lot"), and by execution of a Confirmatory Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration"), dated as of the date hereof and recorded contemporaneously herewith, Steinway and Wildflower have confirmed that the Steinway Land and the Wildflower Land remain a single zoning lot; WHEREAS, the Existing Wildflower Buildings will be demolished and Wildflower intends to construct one or more new buildings (such new building or buildings, together with any future alterations and replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called, collectively, the“Wildflower Buildings,”and     n i      s "Wildflower Parcel");
